The '''1957–58 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 27th since its establishment. The season began on 15 September 1957, and concluded on 4 May 1958. [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] won their sixth title.

[[Real Zaragoza|Zaragoza]] moved from its old stadium [[Estadio Torrero|Torrero]] to the new [[La Romareda]]. [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] also moved from [[Camp de Les Corts|Las Corts]] to the [[Nou Camp]], which became the biggest stadium in Spain.
